meta.title: Bonjour — French Academy
meta.description: On-site path: lessons, grammar, phonetics, writing — A1 to C2.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.p1: Your learning progress (profile, placement, completed units, vocabulary review) is kept in your browser on this device.
privacy.p2: Nothing is sent to a server: there are no cloud accounts yet.
privacy.p3: No ads, no tracking for advertising, and your data is never sold.
privacy.p4: You can export a backup at any time from Settings, and delete the data on this device.
privacy.p2Cloud: With an account, a copy of that progress, your email and your name are stored with our hosting provider, Supabase, so you can find them on any device. Each account can only read its own data. Your password is handled by Supabase and never stored by Bonjour.
privacy.deleteAccount: To delete your account and its data, write to the site owner from the email address of the account.

exam.honestBody: Bonjour prepares you (listening, reading, writing, speaking). The accredited DELF/DALF certificate is issued by an official centre or school — not by this site alone. Our goal: you can pass there once you finish here.
